scripts.test:all: npm run test:playwright && npm run test:performance:all
scripts.test:report:allure: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.test:performance:all: npm run test:performance:smoke; npm run test:performance:load; npm run test:performance:stress; npm run test:performance:spike
scripts.test:performance:report: echo '📊 Performance Reports:' && ls -lh performance-report-*.html 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ No performance reports found. Run performance tests first.'
scripts.test:performance:report:open: open performance-report-*.html 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ No performance reports found. Run performance tests first.'
